title: The last light before the last tree
logline: Three pages before the sequence stops: the path, the last trunk ahead, and the light beyond it so strong the trunk is a black bar. The man's hand at the page's edge not yet on it. The book prints this facing the last tree.

panels.composition: A path ending at a single cedar trunk that stands as a black bar against a light too bright to hold detail, a man's hand at the page's edge reaching but not yet touching it.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a forest path ending at a single cedar trunk standing as a black bar against a light too bright to hold detail with a man's hand at the page's edge reaching but not yet touching, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
